name: HCL Technologies Ltd
read: Management has so far delivered on FY26 revenue and margin guidance and is tracking within its FY27 ranges, though FY27 remains open.

events.label: FY27 company revenue growth guidance
events.quote: Our FY27 growth guidance is now 2.5% to 4%

events.label: FY26 services revenue growth guidance raised
events.to: FY26 services revenue growth 4.75-5.25% cc guided; Q3 FY26 revenue +4.8% YoY cc
events.quote: Guidance raised twice through the year; Q3 growth 4.8% sits within the final 4.75-5.25% range.

events.label: FY26 EBIT margin guidance 17-18%
events.quote: Full-year EBIT margin of 17.2% lands inside the guided 17-18% band.
